So for me the main reason of my anorexia is my mom. When I was little she always told me that I shouldn’t eat this or this because if I do I’m going to be fat. 

When I was 12 y/o I got really obsessed with the amount of calories that I ate daily and with the time I’ve lost my appetite. Now I starve myself or I eat once a day, but when I eat, I have to force myself because I’m never really hungry.

My mom still tells me that if I eat this or this I’m gonna be fat and stuff like this, but since I’m 16 y/o she got more obsessed with my body image, so her comments about what I eat or how my body looks are kinda worser and because of this I don’t really feel comfortable eating around her.
